meta.subtitle: Delivery Dashboard
meta.note: PUBLIC REDACTED COPY. Email addresses, financial figures and partner commercial terms have been removed. Statuses and RAG ratings marked 'proposed' are the PM's working assumption, not stated in the source. The unredacted master is held privately.

priorities.title: Secure the Government extension in writing
Secure the technology partner and start build of SCIEB
Secure the next stage of funding
Get access to the historical data

workPackages.title: Government Extension
workPackages.ragReason: SECURED. The extension has been signed and formally confirmed — the programme's original P1 priority is closed. Remaining work is administrative follow-through, not delivery risk.

tasks.t: Establish the exact current position — who last spoke to the Government contact, and when
Written confirmation received — extension signed and formally confirmed
List every outstanding action sitting on Desider's side and assign an owner to each
Close out those outstanding actions
Chase written confirmation in writing with a named contact and a date
Record extension terms in the contract register — duration, scope, value, break clauses
Escalation route — no longer required, extension secured
Circulate confirmed extension to the exec team and update the funding narrative

workPackages.title: Historical MHL Data Access
workPackages.ragReason: Original priority, not done. The demo and the product's credibility both depend on real historical data.
workPackages.openQuestion: Are we going to get access to the historical data? Where has this got to, and what needs to happen to unlock it?

tasks.t: Define precisely what we need — datasets, fields, date range, volume, refresh frequency
Identify the data owner / gatekeeper at MHL and the decision-maker above them
Diagnose the actual blocker — legal, commercial, technical or political
Draft or progress the Data Sharing Agreement / IG approval as required
Agree secure transfer mechanism, format and anonymisation requirements
Confirm ingestion and validation plan into SCIEB with ValueStack
Agree a fallback — synthetic or sample data — so the demo is not held hostage
Set a weekly chase cadence with a single named owner

workPackages.title: Other Government Opportunities
workPackages.ragReason: Real interest exists but is undocumented and unqualified. No pipeline register today.
workPackages.openQuestion: Which departments/bodies are interested, how real are the opportunities, and what are the actual steps we need to take to win them?

tasks.t: Build a pipeline register — body, contact, sponsor, stage, indicative value, next step
Qualify each opportunity: budget held? sponsor identified? timeline real?
Map the procurement route for each — framework, DPS, direct award, pilot
Write a one-page capture plan per qualified opportunity
Sequence each opportunity against the Government demo (WP7)
Agree bid / no-bid criteria given current capacity
Set a monthly pipeline review slot in the new meeting cadence
Use the signed extension as a live reference and proof point in opportunity conversations

workPackages.title: Funding & Cash Position
workPackages.ragReason: Funding received is materially below plan and constrains near-term delivery. [Figures redacted in this public copy.] Owned by Fouad Malik — finance and cash position sit with him, not the PM.
workPackages.openQuestion: How do we deploy the cash we have, given we are short of plan?

tasks.t: Confirm the latest funding tranche — amount, date and any conditions attached
Rebuild the 13-week rolling cash flow forecast
Quantify the shortfall against plan and restate the runway end date [figures redacted]
Model committed partner cost under the current arrangement
Agree spend controls — approval thresholds and discretionary spend policy
Define trigger points that force the next raise or a cost reduction
Restart next-stage funding conversations and log the investor pipeline [names redacted]
Own the standing finance item at the weekly session (PM schedules it)
Rework the funding narrative around the signed extension — secured revenue de-risks the raise

workPackages.title: ValueStack Commercial Model
workPackages.ragReason: Build is underway (original priority DONE) but the partner commercial model is under active review. [Terms redacted in this public copy.] Khan leads the commercial conversation; Ahmad Mehboob is across the delivery side.
workPackages.openQuestion: Which commercial model do we run with the delivery partner? [Options redacted in this public copy.]

tasks.t: Schedule the dedicated Attiq / Khan decision session
Document the current arrangement — commercial components and notice terms
Model Option A: continue as-is — 12-month impact
Model Option B: alternative structure — trade-offs assessed
Assess delivery risk of each option on the SCIEB build and the demo date
Test ValueStack's appetite before formally proposing a change
Legal review of any amended terms and ownership impact
Record the decision and execute the contract variation

workPackages.title: Pakistan Trip — September
workPackages.ragReason: Four-week lead time means the go/no-go decision is due now. Cost is material against the current position.
workPackages.openQuestion: 3rd or 4th week of September — and is the value worth the spend?

tasks.t: Go / no-go decision against the current position
Fix the window — week commencing 14 Sept or 21 Sept
Confirm who travels and who is needed on the ground
Set a budget cap and get it approved before booking
Book flights and accommodation while fares are still sensible
Check visas, documentation and local logistics
Build the agenda around defined outcomes, not general catch-up
Circulate pre-reads one week before travel
Capture and assign post-trip actions within 48 hours of return

workPackages.title: New Product Government Demo
workPackages.ragReason: Named by the sponsor as one of the most critical upcoming milestones — but no target date is set, which is itself the biggest risk. Khan and Ahmad Mehboob jointly own the build and environment.
workPackages.openQuestion: When are we targeting this, and who needs to be in the room?

tasks.t: SET THE TARGET DATE — this is the single biggest open item
Confirm the Government attendee list and their decision-making authority
Confirm the Desider contingent — Attiq has offered to attend
Define demo scope: which user journeys and which outcomes we are proving
Freeze the build scope with ValueStack and lock a code-freeze date
Prepare the environment and demo data — real MHL data if unlocked, fallback if not
Write the demo script and the leave-behind pack
Dry run 1 — internal, two weeks out
Dry run 2 — full dress rehearsal, one week out
Agree the follow-up pack and re-use plan for the other interested Government bodies

workPackages.title: Governance & Meeting Cadence
workPackages.ragReason: Daily stand-up discipline has lapsed and ownership of priority tracking is an open question raised by the sponsor.
workPackages.openQuestion: Does Attiq carry on chasing admin and organisation, or does it sit with Fouad or Salman?

tasks.t: Confirm ownership of priority tracking and programme admin (sponsor's open question)
Agree the two weekly one-hour sessions — fixed day and time
Issue recurring calendar invites to AQ, FM, KK, AM
Confirm the ValueStack session cadence sits separately and does not collide
Publish a standing agenda template mapped to these work packages
Establish minutes plus a single action log with owner and date for every action
Feed each set of minutes back into this dashboard within 24 hours
Agree an exception-reporting rule — what gets escalated to the sponsor between sessions
